title: Notifications

invitation.label: Invitation to a space

invitation-cancelled.label: Invitation cancelled

member-joined.label: Member joined

member-removed.label: Member removed

removed.label: You were removed

role-changed.label: Your role changed

owner-changed.label: New owner

account-created.description: When an administrator invites someone to join Nido

account-deactivated.label: Account deactivated

account-reactivated.label: Account reactivated

account-deleted.label: Account deleted
